topic: Someone discovers their partner has been writing a novel about them
text: I found the notebooks tucked away in the corner of the attic, beneath a tangle of old blankets and forgotten things. The pages were filled with my life, or at least, what he imagined it to be. It’s a curious thing, discovering your own story told through someone else’s hands. I sit here, the words spilling over my lap, and I can’t help but smile. There’s a part of me that wonders how much of it is true, and how much is the color of his own heart. I’ll ask him about it later, perhaps over dinner. For now, I’ll just read a little more, letting the pages turn softly in my hands.
